'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Double D Invasion. Transcription note: 2002-style form without V boxes; ticked lines may mean (V)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
